lines.q: True or false: goldfish have a three second memory.
lines.a: False! Studies show goldfish can remember things for months.

lines.q: True or false: sea otters hold hands while they sleep.
lines.a: True! It stops them drifting apart on the water.

lines.q: True or false: humans only use ten percent of their brain.
lines.a: False! Brain scans show we use virtually all of it.

lines.q: Last one. True or false: sound travels faster in water than in air.
lines.a: True! About four times faster. Think you can get all four? Go again!
